full_judgment: (b) That in the forthcoming 5th Annual General Meeting 5 (five) Directors Viz Mr Md Nazrul Islam Swapan, Mr Md Altaf Hossain, Mr Mohammad Abdullah, Mr Md Mazakat Harun & Mr Md Fahim Zaman Pathan will retire as per rotation and they are eligible for re-election. But due to limitation imposed for by Bangladesh Bank as to the size of the Board vide BRPD circular No. 12 dated 26-4-2003 only 2 (two) Directors could be accommodated in the next Board and it is agreed upon that Mr Md Nazrul Islam Swapan & Mr Md Altaf Hossain will be re-elected in the Board, rest 3 (three) Directors Mr Mohammad Abdullah, Mr Md Mazakat Harun & Mr Md Fahim Zaman Pathan will be accommodated in the Board after elapsing one term as per amended law & Bangladesh Bank Circular as mentioned above.
